tutorial.info: Quodlibet is an Austrian compendium game: twelve deals arranged as three "wheels" of four contracts each, one of every contract per wheel. The dealer may only pick from the wheel currently in play.
tutorial.scores: **Every score is a penalty and the fewest wins.** A contract you want to win tricks in (Plus) sits at the same table as ones you want to duck (Minus, Bad Neighbour), so always check which one is being played.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand; only the legal cards are highlighted. In the third wheel, Open Trousers hides **your own hand from you alone**, and Good Hunting turns every hand face up.
tutorial.playButton: Select a card and press Play. Pass appears only when Quadrature or Snack leaves you with nothing playable.
tutorial.resetButton: The reset button starts a new game.
